title: Excel Engine & Experimental Features
description: Major release introducing a custom-built Excel-like spreadsheet engine with AI-powered formula generation and a comprehensive experimental features system.
highlights: Custom Excel-like spreadsheet engine built from scratch
AI-powered formula generation from natural language
Experimental features system with WorkOS integration
Multi-tab workspace with complete session isolation

items.title: Custom Excel-like Spreadsheet Engine
items.description: Built from scratch: a powerful, Excel-like spreadsheet with formula support, AI-powered generation, and intelligent workspace management. No third-party dependencies—complete control and customization.
details: Custom formula engine with dependency tracking and automatic recalculation
Support for 50+ Excel functions: SUM, AVERAGE, IF, VLOOKUP, and more
Drag-to-fill with smart formula adjustment (relative references)
Real-time formula autocomplete with function suggestions
Visual formula reference highlighting with color-coded cells
AI-powered formula generation from natural language
Formula error detection and AI-powered debugging
Multi-tab workspace with isolated spreadsheet sessions
Persistent storage per tab with localStorage
Virtualized rendering for smooth performance with 1000+ rows

items.title: Workspace Tab Management
items.description: Professional multi-tab interface inspired by Excel and SQL Server Management Studio, with complete session isolation and persistence.
details: Create unlimited tabs: Chat, SQL Query, or Spreadsheet
Each tab maintains independent content and state
Tab-specific engine instances for spreadsheets
Automatic workspace state persistence across sessions
Visual tab icons and labels for easy identification
Quick tab switching with preserved scroll position and selection
Load database tables directly into new spreadsheet tabs
Duplicate detection prevents creating multiple tabs for same table

items.title: AI Formula Assistant
items.description: Generate complex Excel formulas using natural language. The AI understands your spreadsheet structure and creates accurate formulas with explanations.
details: Natural language to Excel formula conversion
Automatic spreadsheet analysis (headers, data types, sample rows)
Formula preview with reasoning and example results
Ambiguity detection with clarification dialogs
Data modification warnings before applying formulas
Auto-execute mode for instant formula application
Smart row adjustment when applying formulas to columns
Formula history saved to query history for reuse

items.title: Operation Cancellation
items.description: You can now cancel long-running queries and operations with a single click, giving you full control over your database interactions.
details: Cancel button appears in results panel during query execution
Stop button in toolbar for quick cancellation
Graceful cancellation using AbortController for clean resource cleanup
Toast notifications confirm when operations are cancelled
Prevents unnecessary backend load from unwanted queries

items.title: Experimental Features System
items.description: Introducing a comprehensive experimental features system that allows users to request access to cutting-edge features and toggle them on/off in Settings.
details: Request experimental access from the Support page
Manage experimental features in Settings with toggle switches
WorkOS-style feature flags integrated with authentication
Three experimental features: Manual Excel Formulas, Advanced AI Modes, and Query Performance Insights
Feature flags persist across sessions and sync with user authentication
Admin approval workflow for experimental access requests

items.title: Enhanced AI Formula Generation
items.description: AI formula generation now supports a comprehensive library of Excel functions, including advanced mathematical and statistical operations.
details: Added rounding functions: ROUNDUP, ROUNDDOWN, ROUND, CEILING, FLOOR
Expanded math functions: ABS, POWER, SQRT
Text manipulation: CONCATENATE, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, LEN, TRIM, UPPER, LOWER, PROPER
Lookup functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX, MATCH, XLOOKUP
Date functions: TODAY, NOW, DATE, YEAR, MONTH, DAY, DATEDIF
Statistical functions: AVERAGEIF, SUMIF, COUNTIF, MEDIAN, MODE
AI now has explicit knowledge of 50+ Excel functions for better formula suggestions

items.title: Formula Bar Now Experimental
items.description: The Excel-style formula bar is now an experimental feature. Users without experimental access see a clean, simple text input for basic data entry.
details: Default users get a simplified interface with basic text editing
Experimental users get the full Excel-style formula bar with autocomplete
Formula autocomplete, point mode, and AI controls gated behind feature flag
Progressive disclosure - advanced features available when needed
Cleaner default experience for new users
